title: 1989 AMC 8 Problem 10
statement: How many degrees are in the smaller angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock that reads seven o’clock?

solutions.text:
The \(12\) numbers divide the clock into \(12\) equal sections of \(\frac{360^\circ}{12} = 30^\circ\) each.

At seven o’clock the hands point to \(12\) and \(7,\) which are \(5\) sections apart the short way, giving \(5 \times 30^\circ = 150^\circ.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: The \(12\) hour marks split the clock face into \(12\) equal angles
Each hour mark is \(30^\circ;\) at seven o’clock the hands are \(5\) marks apart the short way
